subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Area D: The World Of Work

truths: “Me gusta tocar la guitarra” means “I like playing the guitar”.
“Suelo quedar con mis amigos” means “I usually meet up with my friends”.

rounds.lie: “Las matemáticas me resultan difíciles” means “I find maths easy”.
rounds.why: “Difíciles” means “difficult”, so it means “I find maths difficult”; “easy” would be “fáciles”.
rounds.truth: “Las matemáticas me resultan difíciles” means “I find maths difficult”.

rounds.lie: “Trabajo a tiempo parcial” means “I work full-time”.
rounds.why: “A tiempo parcial” means “part-time”; full-time is “a tiempo completo”.
rounds.truth: “Trabajo a tiempo parcial” means “I work part-time”.

rounds.why: “El sueldo” means “the salary/wage”; it is easily confused with “el suelo” (the floor/ground).
truths: “Trabajar en el extranjero” means “to work abroad”.

rounds.why: “Aprobado” is a pass (“aprobar” = to pass). “A fail” is “un suspenso” (“suspender” = to fail).
“El horario” means “the timetable/schedule”; the horizon is “el horizonte”.
truths: “Sacar buenas notas” means “to get good marks”.

rounds.why: It is a false friend: “la empresa” means “a company/firm”; a promise is “una promesa”.
truths: “Una entrevista de trabajo” means “a job interview”.
